about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get To Know
about.description: I am a Web Applications Development student with a solid systems background (SMR). I am especially motivated by backend development, where I feel most comfortable designing logic and APIs. In my free time I build personal projects, including a full stack fitness tracking platform. I adapt quickly, I am used to Linux environments, and I am highly motivated to keep learning and contribute to a professional team.
